Collision |pvp_ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]6 |pvp_ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.12 |pvp_ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]20 |pvp_speed = 4 |pvp_hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |pvp_lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |pvp_flying = No }} ==Description== The '''Tommy Goon 2''', also referred to as '''Upgraded Tommy Crook''', is a unit that can be spawned from the [[Crook Boss]] at Level 4, replacing the [[Tommy Goon 1]]. On the wiki, it is referred to as ''Tommy Goon 2'' and not ''Tommy Goon'' to differentiate it from the [[Tommy Goon 1]], as they share the same display name in-game. Like most other units, it starts from one of the entrances of the map and moves towards the exit. Whenever there is an enemy in its range, it will stop moving, kneel down and start attacking it and all other detectable enemies in its range. It will continue walking if there are no enemies in its range for a few seconds. The '''Tommy Goon 2''' can detect hidden enemies, though it cannot detect flying enemies. It has a 32.5 second spawnrate. There is a limit of three '''Tommy Goon 2s''' and [[Tommy Goon 1]]s per [[Crook Boss]]. ==Appearance== The '''Tommy Goon 2''' has tan skin. It wears a white shirt, grey vest with golden buttons, dark grey jacket, dark blue tie, a black fedora with a dark blue stripe, brown pants and black shoes.
